articles.headline: The USMNT doesn't need a hero like Pep Guardiola as its next manager
articles.description: The U.S. men's national team is saying goodbye to Mauricio Pochettino while hoping to attract Pep Guardiola as its next manager. But is a superstar coach what this team really needs?

articles.headline: Stoic until the end, Japan's Hajime Moriyasu can finally let emotions flow
articles.description: Even up until the eve of his final game in charge of Japan, Hajime Moriyasu remained solely focused on the task ahead.

articles.headline: Why FIFA reelection will be a formality for Teflon-like Gianni Infantino
articles.description: Despite scandals, controversy and legal challenges, Gianni Infantino looks all but certain to secure a landslide reelection as FIFA president and another four years in charge.

articles.headline: Klopp: FIFA worse under Infantino than Blatter
articles.description: Klopp: FIFA worse under Infantino than Blatter

articles.headline: Meet Como's Nico Paz, the heir to Lionel Messi's Argentina No. 10 shirt
articles.description: Como's Nico Paz has become one of the best young players in Europe, but now he faces the unenviable task of stepping into Lionel Messi's Argentina No. 10 shirt.

articles.headline: Stars set Singapore alight as Japan exact revenge on Brazil with dramatic late win
articles.description: Japan have exacted revenge over Brazil for their World Cup elimination with a dramatic 3-2 win in Singapore on Saturday.
